english.title: Make false representations / omissions in an application for a debt relief order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in

(A)_[making]_
(B)_[providing information to the official receiver in support of]_
(C)_[providing documents to the official receiver in support of]_

an application for a debt relief order, knowingly or recklessly made a false

(D)_[representation]_
(E)_[omission]_

in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF REPRESENTATION OR OMISSION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 251O(1), 251T(3) and 430 of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

english.notes: This offence was inserted by section 108(1) of and Schedule 17 to the Tribunals, Courts and Enforcement Act 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months and / or a five not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years and / or a fine.

Note: In relation to offences committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (limit on magistrates' court powers to impose imprisonment), the reference to "twelve months" is to be read as a reference to "six months".

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
